calculation.expression: where(std_cs(ret_10) > rolling_quantile(std_cs(ret_10), 60, 0.40), -((ret_10 - mean_cs(ret_10)) / clip(realized_vol_20, 0.005, 1.0)), NaN), then lag 1 session
calculation.description: Cross-sectional reversal of 10-day log returns, normalized by 20-day annualized realized volatility, activated when cross-asset 10-day return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-day 40th percentile. The signal is lagged one completed session.

validation.admission_basis: Recent 365d, 730d, and 1095d same-horizon paper IC and ICIR exceed benchmark gates; full-history ICIR is below gate and regime dependence is disclosed.

signal_provenance.lookahead_control: factor shifted one completed session; forward returns begin after signal date

validation.deprecation_reason: Full-history daily ICIR 0.07666 is below the binding 0.0840 admission gate; recent-window strength is not sufficient for admission.
